name: ct_angiography
description: Order a CT angiography (CTA) to evaluate arterial vasculature in any body region. Used for aneurysm detection, dissection evaluation, and peripheral vascular disease.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., aortic dissection, PE, stroke workup)

when_to_use: acute ischemic stroke workup for large vessel occlusion (CTA head and neck)
evaluation of peripheral arterial disease or acute limb ischemia
visceral artery aneurysm or mesenteric ischemia assessment
pre-operative vascular mapping for surgical planning

examples.query: Sudden tearing chest pain radiating to back, blood pressure differential between arms
Acute right-sided weakness and aphasia, within thrombectomy window
